tagline: The largest generator of renewable energy in North America and largest electric utility in the U.S.
hero_kpi_rationale: NEE is the leading North American renewable energy company, and its massive battery storage additions (1.8 GW in 2025) represent a key structural driver for wind and solar integration, positioning the company as a central player in the modern energy transition.

kpis.name: Battery Storage Capacity Additions
kpis.explanation: Battery storage capacity added during the year, in MW.
kpis.description: In 2025, NEE added 1,799 MW of battery storage capacity, a significant increase supported by solar growth and federal tax credits.
kpis.signal: NEE is deploying the largest volume of battery storage in the U.S., critical for renewable grid stability.

kpis.name: Solar Capacity Additions
kpis.explanation: Solar capacity installed during the year, in MW.
kpis.description: In 2025, NEE added 2,859 MW of solar capacity, reinforcing its leadership in renewable energy.
kpis.signal: NEE is the largest solar developer in the U.S., with growth supported by tax credits.

kpis.name: Wind Capacity Additions
kpis.explanation: Wind capacity installed during the year, in MW.
kpis.description: In 2025, NEE added 1,604 MW of wind capacity, as part of its renewable project pipeline.
kpis.signal: NEE remains a major wind player, despite increasing focus on solar and storage.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net profit attributable to NEE after taxes.
kpis.description: NEE's net income was $6.84 billion in 2025, down $111 million compared to 2024.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in 2025 due to Corporate & Other, despite strong growth at FPL and NEER.

kpis.name: FPL Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net profit from the FPL segment, NEE's utility subsidiary.
kpis.description: FPL generated net income of $5.012 billion in 2025, driven by rate base growth and regulatory ROE.
kpis.signal: Robust growth supported by infrastructure investments and regulatory ROE.

kpis.name: NEER Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net profit from the NEER segment, dedicated to renewable projects.
kpis.description: NEER reported net income of $2.975 billion in 2025, a strong increase compared to 2024.
kpis.signal: Strong rebound after 2024 decline, driven by new renewable capacity investments.

risks.title: Complex regulatory and legislative risks
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned at the beginning of the 'Risk Factors' section (Item 1A) and described as 'extensive regulation'. The language used is strong ('materially adversely affect') and the context shows regulation impacts many aspects of operations (rates, costs, permits, etc.). The weighting is high because regulation is central to the energy sector.

risks.title: Inability to recover costs and return on investment
risks.score_rationale: This risk is directly linked to regulatory risk, explicitly stated in the text ('unable to recover in a timely manner any significant amount of costs, a return on certain assets or a reasonable return on invested capital'). The intensity of the language ('materially adversely affect') and the context of rate-setting by regulators justify a high severity.

risks.title: Changes in clean energy support policies
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed in the text, highlighting the company's dependence on government incentives ('governmental incentives or policies that support clean energy'). The strength of the language ('materially adversely affect', 'abandoning the development of clean energy projects') and mention of factors such as budgetary or geopolitical constraints indicate significant severity.

risks.title: Environmental and compliance risks
risks.score_rationale: This risk is clearly stated ('subject to numerous environmental laws, regulations and other standards') and details potential consequences ('capital expenditures, increased operating costs and various liabilities', 'significant civil fines, criminal penalties and other sanctions'). The example of probation following eagle collisions underscores the potential severity.

risks.title: Impact of greenhouse gas emissions limits
risks.score_rationale: This risk is specifically mentioned ('mandating new or additional limits on the production of greenhouse gas emissions') and its consequences are detailed ('substantial additional costs', 'uneconomical to operate'). Uncertainty regarding implementation mechanisms and available technologies increases severity.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence in NextEra Energy Inc.'s 10-K/20-F report.
